faq: What does this tool calculate?
Kilometres from miles at the exact factor 1.609344 — route distances primarily, any length in truth.
Is the calculation done locally?
Yes — instantly in your browser, no account, nothing uploaded.
How accurate is the result?
Exact: the international mile is defined as exactly 1,609.344 metres. No rounding lives in the factor.
Does the route include live traffic?
No. Conversion is units, not routing.
Why is road distance longer than straight-line?
Both units measure the same road once converted. Convert the road figure you actually drove.
A quick mental shortcut?
Miles × 1.6 is within 0.6% — fine for conversation, and this page exists for when 0.6% matters.
The reverse conversion?
Kilometres × 0.621371 — the Kilometers to Miles Route Converter is built for it.
How long is a marathon in each unit?
26.2 miles is 42.16 km — officially 42.195 km. The tiny difference is why races measure courses, not conversions.
Speedometer shows mph, signs show km/h.
Multiply your mph by 1.609344 for the sign's unit — or convert the limit back: 100 km/h is 62.1 mph. Either direction, this page's factor.
US survey miles — different?
Historically distinct by two parts per million and retired from US use in 2023. For road journeys the international mile on this page is the mile.
